world.title: Dangote plans to build 600 million-litre fuel storage facility in Namibia
world.description: The Dangote Group has initiated a NAD41bn (USD2.5bn) petroleum storage and pipeline project in Walvis Bay, in Namibia, according to the Namibian official press agency (NAMPA press release, 05/11/2026). The storage facility will have an estimated capacity of 600 million litres, equivalent to approximately 4 mbl. This will include 360 million litres of diesel, with the remaining capacity (240 million litres) allocated to petrol.
